_doc: Hand-authored creature themes for the small-creature piece animations (themed pass). motifs = the catalogue (g glyph, mo motion, x extra, car carrier, fam = engine fallback family, gap = px of edge per glyph, nm = short name used in notes, desc). creatures.<slug>: pal [main, dark, hi/alt], m = signature motif, m2 = optional second motif (default for guard/heal pieces), pers = place personality, snd = [hurt/trick style, guard/heal style], spd = motion speed (1 = normal), x = optional extra override for the signature motif, notes = identity line, p = per-piece entries for the 4 unique pieces (and any class piece worth a hand note): a string = the note, or {m, n (note), c (colour), lay, car, x}. Class pieces without an entry get an automatic note. Read by build_small_anim.py; see TEMPLATE.md section 9.

cockle-bed.notes: Ridged cockle shells sunk in wet sand, squirting.

p.u0: Shell Snap: ridged shells clap shut
p.u1: Sand Seal: shells sink and rise
p.u2: Squirt Spray: shells squirt jets at spots
p.u3: Gape Wedge: a gaping shell wedges along

tortoise-hatchling-trundle.notes: Tiny soft-shelled tortoise hatchlings, wide-eyed and slow.

p.u0: Sour Nibble: domes drop sour crumbs

u1.n: Weed Spit: domes spit weed out

p.u2: Soft Shell Tuck: domes tuck out and back
p.u3: Trundle Roll: domes trundle slowly along

tundra-vole-swarm.notes: Grey tunnelling voles popping out of snow runways.

p.u0: Vole Burst: mounds burst in a line along the edge
p.u1: Runway Bolt: voles pop in and out of holes
p.u2: Grass Roof: grassy mounds rise
p.u3: Nest Rush: voles rush out of the tunnels
